A concept shared by **10** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #8,501. ## Description

Proposed path-signature-based approach to path-signature time-series forecasting: Encode the ordered evolution of multivariate market data with path-signature features and use them to forecast a defined target; the asset, horizon, and conversion of forecasts into trades remain unspecified. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
